subject: Invitation to Annual Company Gala
body: Dear Team, You are cordially invited to attend our annual company gala, celebrating another successful year of hard work and dedication. Join us for an evening of dinner, dancing, and recognition of outstanding achievements. The event will take place on Friday, December 10th at the Grand Ballroom. RSVP by November 30th to secure your spot. We look forward to celebrating with you! Sincerely, [Your Company]
